text: Figure 7.39: ServiceDependency is the abstract base class of SwcServiceDependency [constr_2027] SwcServiceDependency shall be defined for service ports only⌈A PortPrototype that is referenced by a SwcServiceDependency via assignedPort or via assignedData shall be typed by a PortInterface that has isService set to true at the time when the RTE is generated . This rule does not apply to PortPrototypes referenced by a RoleBasedPortAssignment where the attribute role is set to any of the following values: • NvMService • NvMNotifyJobFinished • NvMNotifyInitBlock • NvMAdmin • NvMMirror • NvDataPort emplate
